$Comment: The way into Hallow's Eve: go and find Old Jack in the Forgotten Temple. Nobody hands it over.
Flow.AutoAccept puts it in every player's quest log while the event runs, at their next login or
world change, and the base's Flow.AutoTrack pins it to their tracker. The _Hallows_Eve folder makes
The one step is a TURN_IN with a blank Target, handed in at the giver: nothing to bring, only the
walk. Old Jack's conversation hands it in from its first screen and goes straight on to Pumpkin
Patch's offer. Keep it that way: a Claim reward or a TurnInAt would leave the quest waiting to be
collected, and the conversation would open the quest list instead of the offer. So its pay table,
Hallows_Eve_Meet_Pay (a small welcome of sweets), sits in Auto, paid the moment it is handed in.
Its Parent's Season makes it absent while the event is off, so its own Requires holds only the Not
group, which keeps it from anyone who already finished Pumpkin Patch. With no Repeat it comes once
per player, ever. Pumpkin Patch does not wait on it: a player whose quest log was full when this
tried to arm still gets the questline from Old Jack.
Beside the table, MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row pays Acrobatics XP for the walk down, in Auto with the
rest. Its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server without that
mod, unpaid and unshown, and the table still pays.
Name: Old_Jack_Meet
